name: CRoW
description: CRoW is a manually-curated, multi-task benchmark that evaluates the ability of models to apply commonsense reasoning in the context of six real-world NLP tasks. It uses commonsense-violating perturbations to test physical, temporal, and social reasoning dimensions.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for commonsense robustness on real NLP tasks, with limited adoption compared to major commonsense benchmarks.
notes: Constructed by rewriting examples from existing datasets with commonsense-violating perturbations; highlights significant performance gap between NLP systems and humans.
